title: Successive input cost recurrence
statement:
For every depth $d\in\mathbb{N}$ and every sign input $x$ of length $3^{d+1}$, let $x_0,x_1,x_2$ be its three length-$3^d$ blocks, let $c_i$ be the randomized tree's expected query cost on $x_i$, and let $y_i$ be the recursive majority value on $x_i$. The expected query cost at depth $d+1$ equals \[ rac{(c_0+c_1+\mathbf{1}_{y_0
e y_1}c_2)+(c_0+c_2+\mathbf{1}_{y_0
e y_2}c_1)+(c_1+c_2+\mathbf{1}_{y_1
e y_2}c_0)}{3},\] where each indicator contributes its accompanying cost when its condition holds and contributes zero otherwise.
